cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You first. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say 'hello' without asking about the gas bill?

mechanism: A confidently directs a reunion conversation but offers a small reciprocal disclosure bargain so B admits attachment first.
confusable: Unlike openly confessing longing, A withholds until B first answers; borrowed authority accommodates format and pace to secure that answer.
comparison: A returning flatmate/partner and key sounds differ from a chair sale used to test attachment.
seedUse: Use D88-a flat/keys/landline/first admission and S02-a directing a flexible order.
